## Overview

**tncensus** provides harmonized delegation-level data from Tunisia's 2014
and 2024 General Population and Housing Censuses (RGPH).

```{r load}
library(tncensus)
data("census_panel")
data("codebook")
data("delegation_crosswalk")
```

The main dataset has `r nrow(census_panel)` rows and `r ncol(census_panel)`
columns. Each of the 45 indicators appears with `_2014`, `_2024`, and
`_change` suffixes.

## The codebook

```{r codebook}
codebook[, c("variable", "domain", "label")]
```

## Example: unemployment change by region

```{r unemployment}
unemp <- aggregate(
  cbind(unemployment_rate_2014, unemployment_rate_2024,
        unemployment_rate_change) ~ region_2024,
  data = census_panel, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE
)
unemp[order(-unemp$unemployment_rate_change), ]
```

## Example: water infrastructure expansion

```{r water}
water <- aggregate(
  pct_sonede_water_change ~ governorate,
  data = census_panel, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE
)
head(water[order(-water$pct_sonede_water_change), ], 10)
```

## The crosswalk

```{r crosswalk}
table(delegation_crosswalk$match_type)
head(delegation_crosswalk[delegation_crosswalk$match_type == "fuzzy",
  c("delegation_2014", "delegation_2024", "gov_2014")], 10)
```

## Scatter plot

```{r scatter, eval = requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)}
library(ggplot2)
matched <- census_panel[census_panel$matched == TRUE, ]
ggplot(matched, aes(x = unemployment_rate_2014, y = unemployment_rate_2024,
                    color = region_2024)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(x = "Unemployment 2014 (%)", y = "Unemployment 2024 (%)",
       color = "Region",
       title = "Unemployment persistence across delegations") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Harmonization log

```{r log, eval = FALSE}
log_path <- system.file("extdata", "harmonization_log.md", package = "tncensus")
file.edit(log_path)
```
